finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The code does not show how `currentBestPath` is populated, but if it includes user-controlled data, it could lead to OS command injection if the data is used in a shell command.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.assumptions: The size of `m->nr_nodes` is not validated or limited, which could lead to a buffer overflow if it is manipulated by an attacker.

finding.title: Use After Free
finding.assumptions: The code does not check if the heap is empty before extracting the minimum element, which could lead to a use-after-free if the heap is manipulated by an attacker.

finding.title: Integer Overflow
finding.assumptions: The size of `m->nr_nodes` is not validated or limited, which could lead to an integer overflow if it is manipulated by an attacker.
